operations.name: export.artifact
operations.description: Export the active document and keep the file in the editor as a retrievable artifact instead of starting a browser download. format "png" is the flattened visible composite (or, with layer_id, that layer's own pixels at its content bounds); "psd" is the layered Photoshop interchange file from File > Save; "pfd" is PhotoFresco's native editable document from Save to My Documents. Returns { artifact_id, format, mime_type, filename, byte_length, sha256, document_id, revision, width, height, layer_id, fidelity, loss, created_at, expires_at }; read the bytes with artifact.read. Artifacts are bound to this caller and document, kept 10 minutes, at most 256.0 MiB each and 16 per caller (the oldest is evicted). Errors: export_failed, export_timeout (120 s), artifact_too_large, artifact_limit, stale_revision (the document changed during the export). Nothing is written to disk.

format.description: png (flattened or one layer), psd (layered interchange) or pfd (native, full fidelity)

layer_id.description: PNG only: export this layer's own pixels instead of the composite

operations.name: export.quick_png
operations.description: Quick Export as PNG with no dialog (browser download). Without layer_id exports the flattened document; with layer_id exports that raster layer. The result only confirms that a download was started, not that a file was saved; to receive the bytes use export.artifact and artifact.read.

layer_id.description: Optional raster layer id; default exports the flattened document
